title: COINTELPRO: The FBI's Own Files
summary: FBI Counter Intelligence Program, authorized by Hoover in 1956. Declassified files show warrantless wiretapping, surreptitious entry, mail opening, paid informants, fabricated correspondence and forged documents against civil-rights, antiwar and other groups — including the 1964 anonymous letter urging MLK to kill himself. Exposed by the 1971 Media, PA office burglary; terminated April 1971. The FBI's own Vault summary concedes it was 'rightfully criticized... for abridging first amendment rights.'
